item.title: Sega GT Online
item.author: Panos Karabelas
item.description: Sega GT Online rebuilt for Windows: a native PC port with modern lighting, HDR, widescreen presentation and restored career features.
item.content: Sega GT Online is being rebuilt as a native Windows port, with modern lighting, widescreen presentation and restored offline features. Explore the improvements and release information.

item.title: Dino Crisis 2
item.author: Panos Karabelas
item.description: Dino Crisis 2 rebuilt for Windows: native gameplay, optional 4× artwork, improved character models and modern controls. An independent project in development.
item.content: Dino Crisis 2 is being recreated for Windows, with optional visual upgrades and restored opening gameplay. Explore the project and release information.
